name: Integrate Palace Properties
author: SAFDAR

sections.description:
Integrate Palace Properties is a WordPress plugin that connects your WordPress website to a secure, cloud-hosted backend service to synchronize property listings from MRI Palace. This plugin provides a simple way to manage real estate listings, automatically updating or removing properties on your WordPress site based on changes detected in your MRI Palace account.

How It Works

The plugin uses the cloud-hosted API service at wp-palace.kiwibrain.co.nz to perform all data fetching, checking, and synchronizing of property listings from MRI Palace. This service regularly pulls property data from your MRI Palace account and checks for any changes, then sends updates to your WordPress site via a webhook to keep your property listings current. Additionally, property images are directly downloaded from the MRI Palace API at api.getpalace.com.

Important Notice

By using this plugin, you acknowledge that the functionality depends on these third-party services, which require an active subscription and secure access credentials. All data is managed securely by this backend service, and we adhere to strict privacy and data security policies to protect user data.

  • For more information about MRI Palace, please visit MRI Palace’s website.
  • Review the backend service’s Privacy Policy for complete information on how your data is handled.

Short Description

A WordPress plugin that integrates with a secure, cloud-hosted backend service to synchronize properties from MRI Palace to your WordPress website.

Usage

Once configured, the plugin and cloud-hosted backend service work together to keep your property listings synchronized:

  • The backend service periodically checks your MRI Palace account for updates.
  • If there are changes to any properties, the backend service sends data over a webhook to update or remove listings on your WordPress website.
  • Images for properties are fetched directly from the MRI Palace API at api.getpalace.com and updated as needed.

License

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress dashboard (this will add a menu item called WP Palace Properties).
  2. Go to WP Palace Properties -> Configs.
  3. Add your MRI Palace credentials.
  4. Add your subscription key if you have one.
  5. Click Save.

The plugin is now set up to work with the backend service and will begin synchronizing your property listings.
